notes:
kr8 0.4.12: Undo puts your own move back even after someone else moved the same tile, and a toast says whose move it replaced. Home opens as a dashboard (Projects, Threads, Forums and your canvases at a glance), board objects can be cut, copied and pasted, and the Home chat lane shows thread replies that were also sent to the channel. Every agent starts a session with a short starting note (the memory Rig) that you can switch off or give a different blueprint, Edit Agent has a Queue / Steer picker, switching the Canvas module off suspends saved pairings instead of deleting them, and publishing your own Home layout asks for a name first.
